# Monthly SIP report e-mail (his-backend cron + email-publisher-service)

**Goal:** hospital management receives, on the 1st of every month at 08:30 WIB, ONE e-mail with a one-page PDF and an Excel
file that say which doctors' SIP (surat izin praktik) is expired or about to expire and how much SOAP documentation depends
on them — and it is never a half or a duplicate delivery.

**Docs:** test doc [sip-report-testing.md](../../sip-report-testing.md) · module features: [module catalogue](../../modules/README.md) (linked on every story).

Surfaces under test:

| Surface                                                                                             | Target                  | Spec folder                         |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `cmd/_cronlike/sipreportmonthly` (query + PDF + XLSX), run in DRY-RUN mode against the staging DB   | his-backend             | `tests/mq/his-backend/`             |
| Delivery of one e-mail with two `attachment_links` (MinIO → SMTP), local RabbitMQ + mailpit + MinIO | email-publisher-service | `tests/mq/email-publisher-service/` |

Recipients and the on/off switch live in `master_config` section `sip.report.monthly` (his-v3-database v0152). A test never
runs the cron without dry-run: that would e-mail the configured recipients.

## User stories

- **US-SIPRPT-01** ([A11.05](../../modules/A-core.md#f-a11-05)) — As a hospital director I want a monthly list of doctors whose SIP is expired or expiring so that I can have the licences renewed before doctors must stop practising.
- **US-SIPRPT-02** ([A11.05](../../modules/A-core.md#f-a11-05)) — As a hospital director I want the PDF briefing and the Excel list in the same e-mail so that I can read the summary and forward the details to HR without asking for them.
- **US-SIPRPT-03** ([A11.05](../../modules/A-core.md#f-a11-05)) — As an operator I want the cron to fail loudly or skip safely (no recipients, disabled, already sent) so that management never gets a wrong or duplicate e-mail.

## Not covered by this epic

- The cron's scheduler (host crontab `CRON_TZ=Asia/Jakarta`, `30 8 1 * *`) is deployment configuration, documented in
  his-backend `cmd/_cronlike/sipreportmonthly/README.md`; it is not testable from here.
- Rendering quality of the PDF (layout, wording) is reviewed visually, not asserted.
